embedded_trainer_paths: Historical SentencePiece TrainerSpec paths are not used to load or run the tokenizer.
text_projection: Replace document-internal line breaks with spaces before SentencePiece encoding; canonical processed text is unchanged.

training_provenance.newline_policy: Internal line breaks are replaced with spaces only in the SentencePiece trainer input.
training_provenance.selection_rule: First documents in the processed train parquet, which is sorted by SHA-256 document_id.
